title.zh: 【XRP Ledger 已修复可导致越权铸币的漏洞，XRP 本身不受影响】
title.en: 【XRP Ledger 已修复可导致越权铸币的漏洞，XRP 本身不受影响】

current_state.zh: The XRP Ledger activated the fixCleanup3_4_0 amendment to patch a permission-delegation flaw that could have allowed burn-only authorized accounts to mint tokens for issued assets such as stablecoins, while XRP itself was unaffected and no exploitation has been confirmed.
current_state.en: The XRP Ledger activated the fixCleanup3_4_0 amendment to patch a permission-delegation flaw that could have allowed burn-only authorized accounts to mint tokens for issued assets such as stablecoins, while XRP itself was unaffected and no exploitation has been confirmed.
